subject: general
question: Which of the following is an ore of aluminium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bauxite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bauxite** is the primary ore of aluminium.
 
• It consists mainly of the minerals gibbsite (Al(OH)₃), boehmite (γ-AlO(OH)), and diaspore (α-AlO(OH)), along with iron oxides, silica, and other impurities.
 
• Aluminium is extracted from bauxite through the Bayer process, which involves refining bauxite to obtain alumina (aluminium oxide), and then smelting alumina to produce aluminium metal.
 
• Bauxite deposits are typically found in tropical and subtropical regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Siderite** is an ore of iron, not aluminium. It primarily contains iron carbonate (FeCO₃).
 
• **Monazite** is a rare earth phosphate mineral containing thorium and cerium, and is not an ore of aluminium.
 
• **Hematite** is another ore of iron, consisting mainly of iron oxide (Fe₂O₃).
 
• Aluminium is the most abundant metal in the Earth's crust, and bauxite is its most important commercial ore.
